cases.case_label: Alu insertion in exon 9 of MAK (Jewish founder)
cases.mechanism_detail: Homozygous Alu in MAK exon 9; in patient iPSC-derived retinal precursors the developmental switch to the retinal transcript containing exons 9 and 12 failed to occur, leaving the exon-9-lacking isoform.
cases.quote: However, in the proband with the Alu insertion, the developmental switch to the MAK transcript bearing exons 9 and 12 did not occur.
